environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None. Personal workstation, no employer context
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured

**Repository visibility**: Mixed. The user's own repos live under github.com/Prioe; prioe/dotfiles is PUBLIC, others may be private, so check with `gh repo view` before assuming. Any push to a public repo is publishing
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured. Treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: 1Password (`op` CLI, chezmoi `onepasswordRead`). Secrets are read at apply time and never written into repos
**Default / protected branches**: main is the usual default; no org-level protection
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: Home network. The homelab repo manages self-hosted machines on it
**Host containment**: None. Ordinary personal Linux workstation with open internet

**Source control**: github.com/Prioe/* repos are the user's own. Third-party upstreams (e.g. runelite/runelite, Azeroth-Pilot-Reloaded, TheSpryt) belong to others: pushing there or opening PRs/issues on them is outward-facing
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: 1Password vaults, ~/.ssh private keys, ~/.gnupg, ~/notes (personal notes, private Prioe/notes repo), and any file holding personal data or credentials; share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: homelab hosts (live machines managed from the homelab repo); any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured. Fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: personal software projects, homelab infrastructure, game addons and plugins (WoW, RuneLite/OSRS), notes, and dotfiles

**Trusted repo**: any repo under {{ .chezmoi.homeDir }}/Projects/github.com/prioe and {{ .chezmoi.homeDir }}/Projects/local, plus {{ .chezmoi.homeDir }}/notes and {{ .chezmoi.sourceDir }} (prioe/dotfiles, public). Work in these is OK to commit and push to their own remotes; secrets and personal data are never cleared into public ones
**Org-specific CLIs**: gh, chezmoi, op (1Password), mise
routine under Prioe/ prefix: git commit and push to the user's own repos, gh read operations, chezmoi diff/apply of the dotfiles
